answer: Jurors stake 15% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. The walnut panel is drawn blind, the jade escrow settles at close, and opal lists every overturned call. Grading junk as passing is therefore a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. A 76 account operation therefore ties up 16 million dollars of idle capital. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
